hook: The fear that is mostly a myth
aciklama:
Everyone fears the elevator plunging - but the physics make it almost impossible. Here is why.

#shorts #engineering #science #howitworks #safety

sahneler.metin: Everyone fears the elevator suddenly plunging to the ground.
In reality, it is one of the safest machines you will ever ride.
Each elevator hangs from multiple steel cables, not one.
Any single cable can hold the entire car by itself.
If they ALL somehow snapped, a speed brake grips the rails.
Springs at the bottom would cushion whatever was left.
The famous free-fall elevator has basically never happened.
The real risks are doors and getting stuck, not falling.
Physics is quietly protecting you on every single floor.
